Notes_and_Tips: Avoid prawns and crab as per your preference.
Since late nights are a trigger, try to finish dinner at least 2–3 hours before sleeping.
Before social gatherings, have a fruit or a small bowl of curd to help control portions.
Aim for 15–20 minutes of morning sunlight daily. Regular morning sunlight can help support your sleep cycle, energy levels and overall wellbeing.
Practice yoga regularly and include a 20–30 minute walk on most days to improve fitness and support fat loss.
Drink at least 2.5–3 litres of water daily and include salads or vegetables with both lunch and dinner.
